notes.title: The Ice Giant Update
notes.content:
[p]The Pale Deep version 1.2, or rather it's new and much cooler name, "The Ice Giant Update" is officially out now! This update adds new content, addresses many changes that y'all have requested, fixes some bugs, and has some other neat tweaks that I think really improve the game![/p][p][/p][p]Here's a complete list of everything new![/p][list][*][p][b]Challenge Mode (Higher spawn rates and a limited number of cadets)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Endless Mode (Instead of the usual ending, the game keeps going and gets harder)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessibility mode in the settings menu (Adds audio captions for sound-dependent mechanics)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Discord link in the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Additional in-game text to make some ambiguous features more clear[/p][/*][*][p]Visual tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][list][*][p]You no longer spin indefinitely after pausing while holding down a direction[/p][/*][*][p]If disabled, the 3D effect no longer gets automatically re-enabled upon rebooting the game[/p][/*][*][p]If you shut off the power while the audio recorder is playing during the blackout sequence, the music now returns to its default volume instead of remaining at the quieter volume it changes to while the audio recorder is playing[/p][/*][*][p]The slowest descent speed now makes a lower pitch of the chain descending sound instead of silence[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you run into any issues, be sure to let me know on the game's Steam discussion board, or in the game's Discord server! (I've tested the update quite thoroughly, but yah never know, especially as a solo dev)[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, I hope y'all enjoy the update!!!

-Casey[/p]

tags.feature: Challenge Mode (Higher spawn rates and a limited number of cadets)
Endless Mode (Instead of the usual ending, the game keeps going and gets harder)
Accessibility mode in the settings menu (Adds audio captions for sound-dependent mechanics)
Discord link in the settings menu
Additional in-game text to make some ambiguous features more clear

tags.bug: You no longer spin indefinitely after pausing while holding down a direction
If disabled, the 3D effect no longer gets automatically re-enabled upon rebooting the game

If you shut off the power while the audio recorder is playing during the blackout sequence, the music now returns to its default volume instead of remaining at the quieter volume it changes to while the audio recorder is playing
The slowest descent speed now makes a lower pitch of the chain descending sound instead of silence

notes.title: Update 1.2 (EXPERIMENTAL)
notes.content: [p]Hey guys! I just wanted to let y'all know that an experimental version of the content update I've been working on is now available if you'd like to help me iron out the bugs! You can opt into this version by right clicking on the game in your library > going to properties > betas > and then setting "beta participation" to "experimental". [b][u]WARNING: This version has not yet been extensively tested and is almost certain to contain bugs. I cannot guarantee the safety of your save file if you choose to opt into this version.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]The default branch of the game is staying the same (and most importantly, stable). So, if you don't want to risk losing your save file or running into major bugs, stay on the default branch! However, if you are willing to risk your save file to access the new features, it would really help me out if you could report to me how your experience has been and if you've run into any issues! The best place to reach me is the Discord server, which you can find a link to at the top of the community hub for the game, or in the options menu on the experimental branch![/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, here's what the experimental update brings with it![/p][list][*][p][b]New Challenge Mode[/b] where you have a limited number of cadets to complete the game with and spawn rates are higher[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Endless Mode[/b] where the game's ending is absent and instead keeps going and gets harder[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Improvements and bug fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Settings can now be accessed before the tutorial (finally)[/p][/*][*][p]A few button prompts that have been requested for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades menu now clarifies what upgrading equipment does[/p][/*][*][p]Discord link has been added to the options menu[/p][/*][*][p]You no longer spin around indefinitely if you pause the game while holding a direction[/p][/*][*][p]If you disable the 3D effect, it no longer gets automatically reenabled after closing the game[/p][/*][*][p]Some slight visual improvements[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope y'all are still enjoying the nice, safe, stable version of The Pale Deep, and I hope those who opt into the new experimental version enjoy the SCARY, UNPREDICTABLE, DANGEROUS version of The Pale Deep as well![/p]

[b]New Endless Mode[/b] where the game's ending is absent and instead keeps going and gets harder

notes.title: July 18th Panic Patch
notes.content:
[p]Hey guys! As you may be aware, I released a small update the other day that added a settings button to the main menu, as a few people have requested. This has taught me a valuable lesson in programming, that no matter how small a feature is, don't underestimate its ability to break the entire game. Due to a bug that came along with this update, some people have lost their save files. The game has since been reverted to the launch version which is free of this bug, and I'm going to hold off on implementing the options button on the main menu and will instead add it alongside the content update I'm working on, since that update will get extensive testing.[/p][p][/p][p]Make sure that the game is updated to the latest version before playing to make sure you don't lose your save file (if there isn't a settings/gear icon in the top right of the main menu, you're all good. If there is, close the game and update it).[/p][p][/p][p]I'm really sorry to anyone who lost their save file because of this bug, it's totally on me, I should've done more extensive testing before releasing the update. But again, the game is now back to its quite extensively tested launch version, so all should be well now, and I won't be updating the game again until the proper content update is finished and properly tested.

In case you're curious, here's what I'm currently working on/planning for the update![/p][list][*][p]Challenge mode with higher spawn-rates and limited cadets[/p][/*][*][p]Endless mode[/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I'm seriously really sorry to anyone who lost their save data, and I will make absolutely sure nothing like this happens in the future!! I hope you'll still enjoy The Pale Deep!!!

Thanks and... apologies,
Casey[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658901/4dca8e0e131c626b78b1da68ef7778dc121e2238.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: added a settings button to the main menu

the game is now back to its quite extensively tested launch version, so all should be well now
